description: The Entringer number E(n, k). E(1, 1) is 1, and E(n, k) = E(n, k-1) + E(n-1, n-k). E(5, 2) is 10, and E(6, 3) is 46. The last entry E(n, n) is the zigzag number a(n). n and k run from 1 to 40, and k must not pass n. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/entringer
